text:
katie: Noticed uptick in fncall schema rejects on canary after eviction-window change. From baseline 0.4% to 1.9% over 3 hours.
ben: Charts? looks like rejects concentrated on long-context routes and streaming responses.
katie: Sample validator log: `fncall-validator: required 'output.result' missing after parse`
lee: Could be streaming EOFs due to kvcache eviction. Our validator currently treats incomplete JSON as hard reject.
ben: We enabled strict_output=true for the canary to tighten rollouts. That might be the cause.
katie: Here's anonymized payload: {"tool":"extract_entities","args":{"text":"<redacted>"},"kv_window":256}
lee: To confirm, can we hook the streaming layer to tag responses that ended with premature EOF? Then soft-fail validator for those cases and emit metric 'fncall.partial_eof'.
ben: Agreed. Also add dimension eviction_policy and kv_window to the metric tags so dashboard can slice.
product-ux: Console ask: show 'partial_eof rate' next to hard rejects and provide quick links to 5 anonymized sample traces.
ops-bot: Ticket CONSOLE-1295 created for new panel 'Fncall partial vs hard rejects' assigned @product-ux.
lee: Hotfix plan: flip strict_output=false for canary > 10% and enable 5% sampling of raw tool responses (store first 2k chars + hash). Ensure redaction.
katie: I'll patch routing rules to temporarily increase sampling for routes matching 'extract-*' while eviction-policy tag active.
ben: Also add alert: if partial_eof > 0.7% AND hard_rejects delta > 0.5% in 30m -> notify eng-platform on-call.
lee: Pseudocode to detect in runtime:
```
if (streaming && ended_with_eof && bytes_total < expected_length) {
  tag_metric('fncall.partial_eof', 1, {route_id, eviction_policy, kv_window});
  validator_mode = 'soft';
}
```
product-ux: For privacy make sampled traces debug_only and purge after 72h.
ops-bot: Deploy plan r-evict-rollfix-20251110 scheduled at 2025-11-10T02:00Z by @lee.
katie: Watching dashboards. Revisit in 90 minutes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
